decisions.rationale: row_count=13014 and duplicate_row_rate=0.0, with airport_code distinct_count=3 and observed_hour_utc distinct_count=4341 (3*4341=13023, close to the actual 13014), suggest one row per airport per UTC hour; both columns carry null_rate=0.0, satisfying the grain-key requirement. wind_gust_mph null_rate=0.745505, pressure_mb null_rate=0.114953, wind_dir_degrees null_rate=0.016828, and wind_speed_mph null_rate=0.000154 are retained as nullable per the profiled null rates; code sets required=false for each.

visibility_miles distinct_count=20 equals the profiler's max_distinct_values cap exactly and the listed values (0.0 to 10.0 in small increments) read as a rounded continuous measurement rather than a closed categorical domain, so accepted_values_subset was not applied; non_negative was applied instead given min=0.0.

purpose: This table holds hourly surface weather observations for three New York City-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) from January through June 2013, combining measured weather variables for each airport-hour with static airport reference attributes (name, municipality, elevation, longest runway).
usage: Each row represents one airport's weather observation for one UTC hour, identified by the pair (airport_code, observed_hour_utc); use observed_date_local and observed_hour_local to read the same timestamp in local time, and join on airport_code to relate rows to the same airport's reference attributes, which repeat identically across all of that airport's rows.
limitations: The profile cannot confirm which column set is truly unique per row; duplicate_row_rate=0.0 only shows whole rows are distinct, so the proposed grain (airport_code, observed_hour_utc) is unverified until the deterministic grain check runs against the warehouse. wind_gust_mph is missing 74.6% of the time and pressure_mb 11.5% of the time, so both remain nullable; reviewers should confirm whether these gaps reflect sensors not installed at some sites or genuine missing readings. captured_at is a tightly clustered timestamp (3 distinct values within seconds, dated 2026) that looks like a pipeline-generated capture time even though the profile marks is_airbyte_metadata as false; reviewers should re-check this classification. airport_name, airport_municipality, airport_elevation_ft, and airport_longest_runway_ft are static airport attributes that repeat across every row for the same airport; the profile cannot confirm whether this denormalization is intentional or should be moved to a separate reference table.
